nodes.title: Ongoing support
nodes.goal: The product operating model holds because funding and prioritization follow the products.
nodes.summary: Once the products are formal: guidance on how products get funded and how work is prioritized within them, woven into Farm Bureau's existing practices.

nodes.title: Apply the actions that come out
nodes.detail: Workshops are only effective if they are followed up on.

nodes.title: Watch for old habits
nodes.detail: Transformations stall when old habits persist after products and owners are defined.

nodes.title: Prioritize within each product
nodes.detail: Initiatives are prioritized by economic value inside the product's budget.

nodes.title: Fund products, not projects
nodes.detail: Each product gets a budget and the money is fungible within it.
